title: Zombie Outbreak Day 2: The Rescue Boat (2/3)

characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI; one flip-flop left after Day 1
characters.Captain Reyes: coast guard skipper, orange jacket, cap, voice [man]
characters.Dale: survivor in a grey long-sleeve, hiding a bite on his arm
characters.Fisherman: old man in a green raincoat, voice [man]

scenes.narration: Something is knocking inside the locked cabin. And one survivor is hiding his arm.
[man] My engineer. [man] He got bitten pulling you out of the water.
[man] I couldn't do it. [man] So I locked the door.
Then Tess noticed the shoreline. It was getting bigger.
The tide had turned. The boat was drifting back to the beach.
And on the sand, they were waiting. Hundreds now.
No engine. No oars. One hour until they hit the sand.
Kai looked at the anchor. [kai] Drop it, now!
An anchor stops a drifting boat. But only if the rope reaches the bottom.
It didn't. The anchor hung twenty feet short.
So they tied on everything. Dock lines. Belts. The tarp.
The anchor hit the bottom. The rope went tight. The boat stopped.
Two hundred yards from the beach.
Everyone cheered. Everyone except the man with the sleeve.
He was sweating. Shaking. And his eyes were turning white.
Then the knocking stopped, and the cabin handle began to turn.
Jump in? Part three is next.
